info.title: AgentPod Live Activity tokens
info.description: Where the AgentPod hub pushes a reader's fleet Live Activity. The SuperMessage app registers the APNs tokens ActivityKit gives it (a push-to-start token per device, an update token per running activity) and removes them when an activity ends or the person signs out. Written from AgentPod's routes on main (apps/hub/src/routes/live-activity.ts, mounted at /_supermessage/v1/live-activity in apps/hub/src/index.ts) and its zod schemas (packages/contract/src/fleet-live.ts). Every refusal is matrix-error.v1, the Matrix client-server error body, because the caller is a Matrix client. The checks run in this order: the push gateway is configured (503 M_UNRECOGNIZED), a bearer token is present (401 M_MISSING_TOKEN), the homeserver's whoami answers (502 M_UNKNOWN) and accepts it (401 M_UNKNOWN_TOKEN), the body is at most 4 KiB (413 M_TOO_LARGE), and the body parses as the route's shape (400 M_BAD_JSON). What the hub then pushes to Apple is schemas/agentpod/live-activity-payload.v1.json.

servers.description: An AgentPod hub. The app calls it on its push gateway's origin, outside /api/*.

post.summary: Register an APNs token for the caller's fleet Live Activity
post.description: The row's owner is the user id the homeserver's whoami returns for the access token; a body cannot name one. A `start` token is the device's push-to-start token, one per device; an `update` token belongs to one running activity, named by `activity_id`, which a `start` token's row ignores. Registering again for the same device (and, for an update token, the same activity) replaces the token. A `device_id` other than the session's device is accepted and logged. The hub stores the token lower-cased.

delete.summary: Remove the caller's APNs tokens of a kind from a device
delete.description: Removes the caller's `start` token from `device_id`, or its `update` tokens: the one activity's when `activity_id` is given, every one the device has when it is not (the app signing out). A `start` removal ignores `activity_id`. Removing a token that is not there is still 204.

matrixAccessToken.description: The SuperMessage session's Matrix access token, `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The hub checks it with the homeserver's `GET /_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami` and caches a success for 60 seconds, keyed by a hash of the token. A whoami that answers other than 200 with an `@` user id is M_UNKNOWN_TOKEN; one that cannot be reached, or answers 5xx, is M_UNKNOWN.

BadJson.description: M_BAD_JSON: the body is not JSON, or not the route's shape

Unauthorized.description: M_MISSING_TOKEN: no bearer token; M_UNKNOWN_TOKEN: the homeserver does not know it

TooLarge.description: M_TOO_LARGE: the body is over 4 KiB

HomeserverUnreachable.description: M_UNKNOWN: the homeserver's whoami could not be reached

NotConfigured.description: M_UNRECOGNIZED: the hub's push gateway is not configured, so it stores no tokens

TokenKind.description: `start`: the device's push-to-start token. `update`: one running activity's token.

DeviceId.description: The Matrix device id of the app's session.

TokenRegistration.description: LiveActivityTokenRegistration. Unknown keys are dropped, not refused, as zod's default object does.

token.description: The APNs token, hex. Push-to-start tokens run longer than device tokens.

environment.description: The APNs environment the token is for: the signing profile's `aps-environment`.

TokenRemoval.description: LiveActivityTokenRemoval. Unknown keys are dropped, not refused.
